title: Makrani dialect
description: Major dialect group of Balochi spoken in Pakistan and Iran
extract: Makrani, or Southern Balochi, is a variety of the Balochi language spoken in the historical region of Makran in Balochistan in Pakistan as well as Iran. The Makrani dialect is spoken by the Baloch people and has been significantly influenced by Persian language.
